prior_information: All 185 original 2022-2025 evaluations and November 2026 summaries have already been inspected. This is a retrospective correction study, not new blind validation or independent ground truth.
selection_score: WAPE + (1 - category agreement), all 12 months of 2021; no test-year metric is used for selection
selection_rule: Choose the lowest development score, tie order as listed. Retain quarter_ratio unless the candidate improves that score by at least 10%. If development support is insufficient or any candidate lacks complete predictions, retain quarter_ratio. Refit the selected model on 2019-2021 without altering its declared parameters.
support_and_acceptance: Apply the original global-185-v1 training/test support, WAPE, signed bias, category agreement, per-category recall and rare-event thresholds unchanged. Pooled/shrunken models cannot bypass insufficient national quarterly support.
additional_diagnostics: threshold-distance sensitivity, not a relaxed acceptance test
paired country bootstrap with seed 20261114, 2000 resamples; exploratory uncertainty, not external validation
deployment_policy: Preserve every original atlas model and fallback. Publish all candidates and the locked selector as a separate research panel. Do not promote a model by choosing the best result from the 2022-2025 outcomes.
data_policy: Use the identical pinned source corpus, polygon masks, confidence filters and occupied-cell/day metric. Spatial predictions may use only earlier fit-year Aqua observations, never same-year Aqua. Unseen spatial cells fall back to the national quarterly ratio. Zero NOAA observations predict zero for supported factors; missing coefficients remain null. No cloud or observation-coverage normalization is claimed.
